import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int src;
        int dst;
        long limit;
        long used;

        Edge(int a, int b, long c) {
            src = a;
            dst = b;
            limit = c;
            used = 0;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        final long big = 1000000000000000000L;
        int vertexCount;
        int srcNode;
        int dstNode;
        List<Edge> edgeList;
        List<List<Integer>> neighborList;
        int[] depth;
        int[] iter;
        Queue<Integer> bfsQueue;

        MaxFlow(int v, int s, int t) {
            vertexCount = v;
            srcNode = s;
            dstNode = t;
            neighborList = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                neighborList.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            depth = new int[v];
            iter = new int[v];
            bfsQueue = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void addConnection(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edgeList.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            edgeList.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            neighborList.get(u).add(edgeList.size() - 2);
            neighborList.get(v).add(edgeList.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean levelGraph() {
            Arrays.fill(depth, -1);
            depth[srcNode] = 0;
            bfsQueue.offer(srcNode);
            while (!bfsQueue.isEmpty()) {
                int u = bfsQueue.poll();
                for (int id : neighborList.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                    if (e.limit - e.used > 0 && depth[e.dst] == -1) {
                        depth[e.dst] = depth[u] + 1;
                        bfsQueue.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return depth[dstNode] != -1;
        }

        long sendFlow(int v, long flowSoFar) {
            if (v == dstNode) return flowSoFar;
            for (int i = iter[v]; i < neighborList.get(v).size(); i++) {
                iter[v] = i;
                int id = neighborList.get(v).get(i);
                Edge e = edgeList.get(id);
                if (depth[e.dst] == depth[v] + 1 && e.limit - e.used > 0) {
                    long flow = sendFlow(e.dst, Math.min(flowSoFar, e.limit - e.used));
                    if (flow > 0) {
                        e.used += flow;
                        edgeList.get(id ^ 1).used -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long computeMaxFlow() {
            long result = 0;
            while (levelGraph()) {
                Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = sendFlow(srcNode, big)) > 0) {
                    result += pushed;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int gridSize, timeBound;
    static String[] land;
    static String[] demand;
    static int[][] shortestTime;
    static int[] dirX = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dirY = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static boolean withinBounds(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < gridSize && c >= 0 && c < gridSize && land[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && land[r].charAt(c) != 'Z';
    }

    static void expandFromZ(int startX, int startY) {
        shortestTime = new int[gridSize][gridSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(shortestTime[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{startX, startY});
        shortestTime[startX][startY] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + dirX[k], ny = y + dirY[k];
                if (withinBounds(nx, ny) && shortestTime[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    shortestTime[nx][ny] = shortestTime[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                if (shortestTime[i][j] == -1) shortestTime[i][j] = 1000000000;
    }

    static int[][][][][] cache;
    static boolean[][][][][] precomputed;

    static boolean pathExists(int step, int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2) {
        if (shortestTime[r1][c1] < step) return false;
        if (r1 == r2 && c1 == c2) return true;
        if (step >= timeBound) return false;
        if (shortestTime[r1][c1] <= step) return false;
        if (precomputed[step][r1][c1][r2][c2]) return cache[step][r1][c1][r2][c2] == 1;
        precomputed[step][r1][c1][r2][c2] = true;
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
            int nr = r1 + dirX[d], nc = c1 + dirY[d];
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= gridSize || nc < 0 || nc >= gridSize) continue;
            if (land[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Y' || land[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Z') continue;
            if (pathExists(step + 1, nr, nc, r2, c2)) {
                cache[step][r1][c1][r2][c2] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        cache[step][r1][c1][r2][c2] = 0;
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        gridSize = sc.nextInt();
        timeBound = sc.nextInt();
        land = new String[gridSize];
        demand = new String[gridSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) land[i] = sc.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) demand[i] = sc.next();

        boolean foundZ = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j) {
                if (land[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    expandFromZ(i, j);
                    foundZ = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (foundZ) break;
        }

        List<int[]> supply = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> capacity = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                if (land[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && land[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && land[i].charAt(j) != '0')
                    supply.add(new int[]{i, j});
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; ++j)
                if (demand[i].charAt(j) != 'Z' && demand[i].charAt(j) != 'Y' && demand[i].charAt(j) != '0')
                    capacity.add(new int[]{i, j});

        int nodeCount = supply.size() + capacity.size() + 2;
        MaxFlow solver = new MaxFlow(nodeCount, 0, nodeCount - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < supply.size(); ++i) {
            long val = land[supply.get(i)[0]].charAt(supply.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            solver.addConnection(0, i + 1, val);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < capacity.size(); ++i) {
            long val = demand[capacity.get(i)[0]].charAt(capacity.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            solver.addConnection(supply.size() + 1 + i, nodeCount - 1, val);
        }

        cache = new int[65][12][12][12][12];
        precomputed = new boolean[65][12][12][12][12];
        for (int i = 0; i < 65; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++)
                for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++)
                    for (int l = 0; l < 12; l++)
                        for (int m = 0; m < 12; m++)
                            precomputed[i][j][k][l][m] = false;

        for (int i = 0; i < supply.size(); ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < capacity.size(); ++j)
                if (pathExists(0, supply.get(i)[0], supply.get(i)[1], capacity.get(j)[0], capacity.get(j)[1]))
                    solver.addConnection(i + 1, supply.size() + 1 + j, 10000000L);

        System.out.println(solver.computeMaxFlow());
    }
}
